module.Title: Count Pump Cycles
module.Teaching: A counter variable records how many times an event occurs. += 1 increments the count.
module.PredictionQuestion: What is cycle_count after the loop?
module.PredictionExplanation: The loop runs three times and adds one each time.
module.DebugPrompt: =+ assigns positive one each time; += is the increment operator.
module.RecallPrompt: Create and increment cycle_count through three cycles. Use these exact identifiers: cycle, range. Use these exact values: 0, 1, 3.
module.TransferPrompt: Count five successful sensor reads. Use these exact identifiers: range, read_count, reading. Use these exact values: 0, 1, 5.
module.PreviewMessage: The dashboard can now track equipment cycles.
